name: @voice-kit/forms
description: voice-kit: a form as the tutor sees it. A FormSpec (text, link, choice and pictures fields), the `form` fragment of a request, the values an answer may fill, requiredFilled and oneQuestion, and formCommand(form), a Command for @voice-kit/talks' registry whose args are built from the fields, so the form's own Send button and the tutor call one path. With the grind part 'Helping him fill in a form'. Imports only types from @voice-kit/talks: no React, no DOM.
